title: SR-GP Evo Anthracite

specs.eps_liner_structure: Multi-Density Segmented EPS Matrix with Integrated Cooling Channels

description: Born for the apex and high-speed straightaways, the Suomy SR-GP Evo Anthracite is designed to deliver razor-sharp aerodynamics in a chin-on-tank tuck. Its Aerospace-Grade 100% Carbon Fiber shell tips the scales at a featherweight 1263g, channeling boundary-layer airflow to maintain a ~92 dB acoustic cabin profile while meeting ECE 22.06, FIM impact standards. The interior leverages moisture-wicking antibacterial liners contoured for an Intermediate Oval fit, integrating eyeglass channels and track-proven Double D-Ring retention.

product_details.description: FIM-homologated race helmet worn in World Superbike Championship.

sizing_fit.fit_notes: Designed for aggressive track tuck; may feel tight on larger head sizes due to race-specific shell geometry.

technical_analysis: Features Advanced multi-composite aerodynamic shell geometry engineered for optimal impact absorption and stability paired with Anti-scratch Class-1 optical shield with Pinlock anti-fog lens compatibility and toolless quick-release. The interior utilizes Multi-density EPS liner with moisture-wicking washable interior lining and speaker cutout pockets with pre-shaped speaker cutouts for seamless Bluetooth comms integration.
marketing_description: Experience the Suomy SR-GP Evo Anthracite: combining Global Certified craftsmanship with Anti-scratch Class-1 optical shield with Pinlock anti-fog lens compatibility and toolless quick-release and Multi-density EPS liner with moisture-wicking washable interior lining and speaker cutout pockets. Perfect for riders who demand uncompromised safety and aero-acoustic comfort.
yoast_title: Suomy SR-GP Evo Anthracite: Specs, Real-World Review & Price Guide
yoast_metadesc: In-depth review of the Suomy SR-GP Evo Anthracite. Tested shell weight, ECE/DOT safety rating, noise dB quietness, and fitment guide for Intermediate Oval heads.

introduction: Positioned in Suomy's Track / Race lineup, the SR-GP Evo Anthracite brings Italian engineering to riders seeking balance between weight, cabin acoustics, and impact protection. Designed for an Intermediate Oval fitment, it connects daily usability with certified ECE 22.06, FIM track safety.
story:
The Suomy SR-GP Evo Anthracite represents Suomy's dedicated protective engineering, incorporating aerodynamic shell sculpting and multi-density EPS impact damping. Its Aerospace-Grade 100% Carbon Fiber shell dampens high-speed wind resonance while multi-density EPS channels absorb kinetic energy across direct and oblique impact vectors.

On the road, intake ports channel air across the scalp, keeping cabin noise around ~92 dB at 100 km/h. For riders seeking an Aerospace-Grade 100% Carbon Fiber Track / Race helmet tailored to an Intermediate Oval head shape, the Suomy SR-GP Evo Anthracite delivers verified safety and long-distance rider comfort.
